system.description: This combination Discipline allows you to assess any single statement made by a living subject and look for the essence of that subject's being beneath the words spoken. You need speak no words yourself; you simply interpret the statement offered to you and, with even a single success, determine the subject's Demeanor. This power works only upon living creatures — Kindred lack the spark of life that colors the words they speak, and so cannot be read this way.
system.source: Clanbook: Ventrue, Chapter Two: The King is Dead, Long Live the King
